payload.title: File:Catchin' Rays (34811990914).jpg
payload.artist_html: Jason Jacobs from Honolulu, USA
payload.description_html: Geckos are common and beloved bug catchers here in the Islands. This one's got it figured out. By hiding on the light, he gets an easy meal from the moths and gnats that are attracted to the light while also keeping warm on a cool night.
